itens.trecho: I'm not a fan of high violence or gang movies. Dexter, Breaking Bad, etc., aren't my thing. The trailer didn't motivate me either; it actually discouraged me. I gave it 15 minutes, but I couldn't stop watching. It's somewhat of a modern day Godfather and again the dynamic of the family and all the players pulls you in.

"Mobland" is a larger than life but nonetheless watchable, Brit crime drama. This series feels somewhat like a satire, of your British organised crime, figures.Its loud tones, predictable stereotypes and at times implausible plot twists, do tend to rob it, of certain, credibility.

Mobland is an entertaining gangster story. That's it. Nothing spectacular and nothing mediocre. With Guy Ritchie involved in the series there is indeed that classic many plots intermingling in the overall story treatment. One thing that stands out in this series is Pierce Brosnan's performance. Definitely not Tom Hardy's.
